research_question: Can measured executable-source binding be moved to registration/deployment boundaries while a lightweight hot-path sentinel preserves same-process mutation detection at practical cost?
claim_boundary: Posthoc mechanism calibration on the known H7I Kornia replay pipeline plus synthetic source-index unit fixtures. It is not blind, cross-framework, or malicious-sandbox evidence.

boundaries.registration: Build the portable canonical executable index and bind the actually measured repository identity.
boundaries.deployment: Rebuild and compare the canonical index, then create a process-local callable sentinel.
boundaries.hot_path: Compare function/code identities and dependency fingerprints without Git subprocesses, source-file reads, inspect.getsource, or AST parsing.
boundaries.execution: This experiment detects mutations present before the hot check. Concurrent mutation between check and use remains a TOCTOU limitation unless execution is sealed and output is buffered.

policies.cached_digest_only: After successful deployment validation, trusts the cached digest and runs lineage_v1 without checking whether resolved callables changed.
policies.hot_callable_sentinel: Runs lineage_v1 plus a process-local callable/code/default/closure/global dependency sentinel; unsupported resolution returns Unknown and fails closed.
policies.cold_reindex: Rebuilds the full canonical executable index for every decision; retained as a correctness and cost reference, not a proposed hot-path design.

canonicalization: Ignore source locations, formatting, comments and function/class docstrings.
Preserve executable AST, code-object digest, defaults, keyword defaults and closure values.
Record referenced immutable globals and callable/module origins; unresolved mutable or native dependencies become Unknown.
Record every wrapper layer rather than discarding behavior through inspect.unwrap.
Bind module origin relative to the measured repository root when possible; otherwise bind the resolved absolute origin.
cost_metrics: sentinel hot validation latency over at least 100 repetitions
success_gates: hot_callable_sentinel preserves both benign Kornia controls
hot_callable_sentinel rejects all three supported post-deployment mutation classes
native/uninspectable override is Unknown rather than admitted
all nine source-index fixture expectations hold
median sentinel-only hot check is <= 10 ms and <= 10% of median cold reindex
the hot check executes no Git subprocess and no source/AST indexing path
falsification_rules: If cached_digest_only admits post-deployment callable drift, cached digest alone is not a valid runtime source binding.
If the sentinel cannot detect same-function __code__ replacement or dependency drift without cold parsing, the proposed cache boundary is insufficient.
If unsupported callables are admitted, measured-source v2 is no-go.
If benign controls change digest, report over-invalidation rather than counting conservative rejection as success.
Passing this protocol does not address mutation concurrent with execution, native extension internals, or cross-process portability of process-local identities.
